description: This file contains the abstract class StatementBase, which provides a base implementation for database statement handling in Drupal, including event dispatching, fetch modes, and result processing.

classes.name: StatementBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for database statement handling, including event dispatching, fetch modes, and result processing in Drupal.

methods.name: hasClientStatement
methods.description: Checks if the client-level database statement object exists.

methods.name: getClientStatement
methods.description: Returns the client-level database statement object, throws exception if not initialized.

methods.name: getConnectionTarget
methods.description: Returns the target database connection string.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the statement with given arguments and options.

methods.name: dispatchStatementExecutionStartEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event indicating the start of statement execution.

methods.name: dispatchStatementExecutionEndEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event indicating successful completion of statement execution.

methods.name: dispatchStatementExecutionFailureEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event indicating statement execution failure.

methods.name: setFetchMode
methods.description: Sets the fetch mode for retrieving results, with deprecation warning for integer modes.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the next row from the result set according to the fetch mode.

methods.name: fetchObject
methods.description: Fetches the next row as an object, optionally of a specific class.

methods.name: fetchAssoc
methods.description: Fetches the next row as an associative array.

methods.name: fetchField
methods.description: Fetches a single field from the next row.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all remaining rows according to the fetch mode.

methods.name: fetchCol
methods.description: Fetches a single column from all remaining rows.

methods.name: fetchAllAssoc
methods.description: Fetches all rows as an associative array keyed by a specified column.

methods.name: fetchAllKeyed
methods.description: Fetches all rows as a key-value array.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected or throws exception if not enabled.
